Messages.Author: Pat Ricochet
Messages.Body:
(LSJ, skip to the last paragraph)



I know this is partially in the "silly" category, and so isn't really
here for critique, but I'm surprised you don't have even one Compel the
Spirit in there. I mean, Leonardo and Ambrosius both seems to be asking for
it. Also, once you've got a couple Compel the Spirits in the deck, you HAVE
to throw in Scapelli. He seems expensive, but he's usually just tough
enough (especially when you can Compel him back) that his little bleeds of
one just keep getting let through.

And, this kind of begs the question. Death Pact has a retainer symbol
on it, so it kind of is a retainer, though it's not normally equipped. Can
you Compel the Spirit to "regain" a burned Death Pact retainer? And, more
importantly to poor maligned Patrizia, can she fetch it out of your ash
heap, even if you just discarded it? (The bonus of Patrizia over Compel the
Spirit, there, that she can get *discarded* retainers)

--
Pat Ricochet
Soul Jar'rn Fool of Atlanta
